crop.visible_input_object: A full batch-level input schematic: donor-derived cells, donor information, gene expression profiles, contextual metadata, and top expressed genes per cell.
crop.visible_model_interface: The figure presents the batch inputs that are turned into the open-ended QA prompt: cell batch plus gene-expression and donor metadata, without a constrained label set.
crop.rationale: This crop keeps the entire coherent batch-input diagram needed for the open-ended QA route: the donor cell batch, donor metadata, gene-expression matrix, contextual metadata, and top-expressed-gene lists. These are the visible input components described for the model-facing batch prompt. No downstream outputs or performance panels are present, so the smallest faithful crop is essentially the full bordered schematic.
